title: Invariant subring and canonical spectrum map of affine arrows
statement: Let $A$ and $B$ be commutative rings and let $s,t:\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Define the invariant subring $C=\{a\in A:s^\sharp(a)=t^\sharp(a)\}$, where $s^\sharp,t^\sharp:A\to B$ are the contravariant coordinate-ring homomorphisms. Define the canonical morphism $q:\operatorname{Spec}A\to\operatorname{Spec}C$ to be $\operatorname{Spec}$ of the inclusion $C\hookrightarrow A$. These constructions impose no finiteness or equivalence-relation hypothesis on $s,t$.
